title: Consolidate the common Gallery scene descriptor
scope: Replace parallel Gallery context, catalog, asset and capability mappings with one immutable common scene descriptor consumed by the session, CLI, desktop and mobile shells.
acceptance: Each scene's stable ID, asset, name, help, controls, camera, workload flags, broad features and exact interaction requirements are declared once in a common descriptor.
Contract tests prove descriptor order, uniqueness and completeness and show catalog and CLI selection derive from it without platform-maintained scene mappings.
evidence: PASS: common Gallery, registry, input, camera and command Gallery targets built with GCC 12.2.0; desktop CLI help derived all 27 non-default scene options from the descriptor; docs/roadmap/evidence/F7-20-gallery-scene-descriptor.json.

PASS: Gallery registry, input and camera contracts passed 3/3; descriptor order, uniqueness, completeness, workload-feature consistency and 33-key exact-interaction inventory are checked; docs/roadmap/evidence/F7-20-gallery-scene-descriptor.json.
PASS: Vulkan Gallery session contract passed 1/1 in 57.82 seconds on NVIDIA RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU driver 590.44.01; docs/roadmap/evidence/F7-20-gallery-scene-descriptor.json.
